title: Employee onboarding
description: Preparation, first assignments and feedback for a new employee's entry into a team.

sources.title: U.S. Office of Personnel Management, Sample supervisor onboarding checklist

rules.instruction: Before the start date, ask the hiring manager to name an owner for equipment, approved account access, introductions and the first work assignment, and record them in the onboarding plan.
rules.verification: Check that the onboarding plan names an owner for each item and that the access requested lets the role complete the first assignment.

rules.instruction: Ask the manager to schedule onboarding check-ins on role expectations, learning goals and blockers, and record their dates in the onboarding plan.
rules.verification: Open the onboarding plan and check that it lists the check-in dates and topics.

rules.instruction: Record each blocker raised at a check-in in the onboarding plan, with an owner and a follow-up date.
rules.verification: Check that every open blocker in the onboarding plan names an owner and a follow-up date the employee can see.
